msg: There are 8 gnome colours, and 2 basket colours (red and yellow). Each gnome has a coloured hat that tells you which basket they will give you. Brown, red, pink and purple hats lead to the red basket and blue, orange, green and yellow hats lead to the yellow basket. Note that this may be different for you, so be careful and learn this in the first few rounds (make notes on paper). The amounts that each basket give you varies over time and you need to try and find this pattern. You should always have a mental note of the "best" basket, and whenever a 5x multiplier appears you should select the gnome that will give you this colour. When you have a 1x multiplier, it's worth occasionally selecting a gnome that shows you the other basket colour so you can check whether it's become better. If so, make that your "best" basket and continue.
